## Project Case Studies
- [Verixa Case Study](https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/verixa): Flagship property decision intelligence platform backed by RERA filings, builder credibility analytics, and PostGIS spatial data.
- [Verixa Live App](https://verixa-phi.vercel.app/): Live production deployment of the Verixa real-estate decision intelligence platform.
- [Exertia Case Study](https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/exertia): Unified workforce management and privacy-first telemetry operating system pairing React with a Python desktop daemon.
- [Veritas Case Study](https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/veritas): Python and Flask civic news analyzer using TF-IDF cosine-similarity perspective clustering.
- [Smart Inventory Case Study](https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/smart-inventory): ACID-compliant Java SE and PostgreSQL JDBC demand forecasting system using Weka ML and Twilio SMS alerts.
- [Smart GST Invoice Case Study](https://zaidmemon.vercel.app/projects/smart-gst-invoice): Automated B2B GST computation, ZXing 2D barcode encoding, and iText PDF synthesis desktop tool.
